instructions: 1. Visit: https://chutes.ai/signup and create an account (pick a username; sign up with Google, GitHub, or optionally link a Bittensor wallet — no card is asked for on this page)
2. Manage billing and create API keys at https://api.chutes.ai (account/billing/API-key management is a separate host from the inference API)

3. Review current token pricing at https://chutes.ai/pricing before making requests — pay-as-you-go per token (USD per 1M tokens) plus optional paid Plus/Pro plans; no free trial credits are documented, so budget for a funded account from the first call
4. Set {apiKeyEnvVar} in your .env file — keys are issued with a cpk_ prefix and must be sent as Authorization: Bearer {apiKeyEnvVar} (X-API-Key is not a supported auth scheme)
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://llm.chutes.ai/v1 (chat completions confirmed via the vendor's own homepage code sample), serving a small TEE (confidential-compute) model roster — 14 ids at the time of writing, confirmed by an unauthenticated GET /v1/models. Billing is pay-as-you-go per token; the pricing page's free-trial FAQ answer is collapsed/unconfirmed and no free-tier language appears elsewhere in the public docs, so billingPolicy is recorded conservatively as no-free-tier pending a live-key check.
